t: An open FPGA board for retro computers, video, and learning chip design.
steps: Buy the GateMateA1-EVB from the Olimex store for about 50 euros.
Get a USB-C cable to connect it to your computer.
Install the open FPGA tools Yosys, nextpnr, and openFPGALoader.
Read the Olimex product page notes for your board revision.
Build a blinky design for the GateMate with Yosys and nextpnr.
Upload it with openFPGALoader and the dirtyJtag cable setting.
Connect a VGA monitor and try a video test pattern next.
meta: Wild Open. From $66.11. A few stores.
